The guitar BGM continues steady in the background with a bright spectral texture. (3) A metallic clinking sound of a ladle hitting the side of a stainless steel bowl is heard twice. An adult male voice enters the mix, speaking in a friendly, conversational tone to the kids. (4) Rhythmic cheering and collective laughter from at least two adults occur. The child makes high-pitched 'Oh yeah' vocalizations, indicating high emotional arousal and positive valence. BGM remains constant. (5) Soft percussive sounds of a plastic spoon hitting a silicone bowl surface are audible. Occasional wet smacking sounds suggest the child is eating heartily, followed by a soft swallow. (6) The child speaks clearly in a Taiwanese dialect, uttering the phrase for 'eating tofu pudding'. Her intonation is rising and playful, indicating excitement and engagement with the food and the speaker. (7) Adult laughter swells in volume as the child makes a funny sound. The acoustic guitar BGM continues without interruption, maintaining a lighthearted and domestic atmosphere throughout the scene. (8) A final vocal tag by the child is heard over the concluding soft guitar note. A brief digital 'pop' sound effect marks the very end of the audio track.
